title: PI objectives — tranche 11 (retrospective, 2026-11-28)
body:
# PI objectives — tranche 11 (retrospective, 2026-11-28)

## Objectives

- **O1 — S14's cutover record is accepted and the project stays active.** After this increment S14 has its charter, seven A–D artefacts, a scope baseline with one WBS deliverable, a live delivery contract, a Phase-G review and a green receipt, and its row is still `active` because #29 is open.
- **O2 — T6 is re-closed through its gate.** After this increment T6's closure review is published with `Outcome vs acceptance`, `Evidence`, `Open items` and `Decision`, its manifest states `closed`, and its receipt is green.
- **O3 — T8 is re-closed through its gate.** After this increment T8's closure review is published with the same four sections, its manifest states `closed`, and its receipt is green.
- **O4 — the tranche's SAFe gaps clear.** After this increment the four cadence rows exist at `period='tranche-11'`, the refinement's WSJF matches all three packs, and the exit gate exits 0 on three fresh receipts.

## Business value

| objective | member | planned business value | benefit |
|---|---|---|---|
| O1 | S14 | 8 | enabling — no direct benefit: the cutover is the platform every linked benefit runs on |
| O2 | T6 | 9 | `B3` Self-development — the development project is the conveyor changing itself with a tested rollback |
| O3 | T8 | 8 | enabling — no direct benefit: the lesson lifecycle is the capability B3's runs record into |
| O4 | tranche | 7 | enabling — `B6` Predictable delivery is measured at tranche reviews, and a stale receipt makes the measurement meaningless |

The planned value is the delivery owner's estimate at planning; the actual value is recorded at the tranche-11 review, never here. `B1` Auditable decisions is carried by the two closure reviews and the plan approval: every judgement in this tranche names its evidence, its approver and its delegation.

## Measurement

Each objective is measured by its member's receipt at the pinned snapshot (`scripts/verify-project.py`), the two published PI outputs' read-back in `docs/outputs.js`, and the exit gate (`scripts/check-tranche-exit.py --tranche 11`). The tranche review reads those three instruments; no objective is marked met from prose.

## Evidence

- `docs/evidence/rework/tranche-11/readiness-gate.md` — the pinned snapshot, the checker runs and the authorisation refusal.
- `docs/evidence/rework/S14.json`, `docs/evidence/rework/T6.json`, `docs/evidence/rework/T8.json` — the receipts at execution.
- `docs/evidence/rework/tranche-11/tranche-exit.json` — the exit gate at execution.
